title: StateFlow and SharedFlow for state that is observed

videos.script: A screen does not read the week once. It watches it, and redraws when the week changes. {{hot}} The flows of the last lesson were cold, a recipe that runs once per collector. State is the opposite: it exists whether anybody is looking or not. A screen that opens late wants the current value, not the story of how it got there. That is a hot flow. {{state}} State flow, which always has a value, gives a new collector the current one first, and skips the values a slow screen could never have shown. {{backing}} The shape every state holder uses: a private mutable state flow, handed out read only, and changed with update. {{shared}} Shared flow, for events rather than state, a message that matters once. {{sharein}} State in and share in, which turn a cold flow hot so that two screens share one producer. {{holder}} And the planner's week as one class, a state holder, the thing Android calls a view model.
